name: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

aliases: what is bruised pride and lion hides
what are the lion hides for
faq.answer: A wounded huntsman or trader needs lion hides to supply a local tanner. In exchange, the giver receives finished leather goods essential to their livelihood.
An injury keeps the giver from hunting lions themselves. They rely on you to uphold a long-standing agreement with a local tanner.
faq.q: Why does the quest giver need help gathering hides?

faq.answer: A local tanner receives the raw hides and processes them into finished leather goods the giver needs for regular trade and work.

aliases: why is it called bruised pride
faq.answer: The name refers to both a pride of lions to hunt and the injured hunter’s pride. The hunter has never failed to deliver on a contract, but their injury now limits them.
faq.q: What does the name 'Bruised Pride and Lion Hides' mean?

faq.answer: Yes. The injury puts the giver’s next delivery at risk. Gathering the lion hides lets them keep their bargain without coming up short.
faq.q: Was the arrangement with the tanner at risk?

faq.answer: The giver suffered an injury that prevents them from hunting lions in the wild. Its exact cause is not given, and delivering the hides lets them preserve their reputation.
faq.q: How was the quest giver injured?

sections.body: A hunter or tradesperson has been hurt and cannot safely track wild beasts. Their agreement with a neighborhood craftsman is still due, so they hire you to hunt wild lions and gather their pelts.
sections.title: A Hunter's Dilemma

sections.body: The raw hides go to a local tanner, who exchanges them for finished leather goods the giver needs for their livelihood. The giver’s pride is stung by needing help, but honoring the bargain keeps their professional reputation unbroken.
sections.title: Honoring the Arrangement

summary: An injury leaves a hunter or tradesperson unable to gather lion hides for a local tanner. They turn to you to keep their trade agreement and their professional record intact.
